title: Recovery of algebraic complexes from constant values on a nonempty slice
statement: Let X be a scheme and B a commutative coefficient ring in the scheme universe. Use the universe-lifted constant-complex realization finiteModelConstantComplex from [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data] and the derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Assume the constant module functor preserves zero morphisms. Let R be a commutative ring sheaf on X pro-etale and phi an isomorphism from the constant B-ring sheaf to R, with derived change as in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let W be a nonempty etale chart and P,Q arbitrary algebraic B-complexes. If their changed constant realizations are isomorphic after the representative-based derived slice restriction to W, then Q(P) and Q(Q) are isomorphic in the algebraic derived category. No adic datum, residue operation, bounds, finite generation or projectivity is assumed.

source.place: Exact point pullback and constant germs: Tags 03CY, 0F6B, 00Y8(3), 05RU; lemma-locally-constant, constant algebraic values

proof.text: Choose an ordinary point x of W using nonemptiness. Set Omega to the algebraic closure of its residue field and y to Spec(Omega) -> Spec(kappa(x)) -> W. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-constant-slice-derived-stalk-comparison] to obtain the common functor F and the comparisons for P and Q. Applying F to the supplied slice isomorphism and conjugating gives an isomorphism between Q of their algebraic universe lifts.

Take a small filtered-free resolution Pprime -> P by [lem-pc-large-filtered-free-resolution]. Universe lift preserves the small coproducts: after forgetting to abelian groups this is the colimit-preserving abelian-group lift, and the forgetful functor reflects colimits. Lift the entire filtration, its split maps, and its cokernel decompositions; reindex the free bases by ULift and identify the twice-lifted rank-one module with the large rank-one module. The lifted resolution is K-projective by [lem-pc-filtered-free-kprojective].

Compose the lifted resolution quasi-isomorphism with the isomorphism from step 1. Mathlib and the adopted exists_Q_map_eq theorem represent this derived morphism out of the lifted K-projective complex by a chain map. Fullness of the lift on complexes gives a small chain map Pprime -> Q. Its lifted localization is an isomorphism, so it is a lifted quasi-isomorphism; exact fully faithful universe lift reflects quasi-isomorphisms. Localizing the small quasi-isomorphism and inverting the small resolution map produces Q(P) isomorphic to Q(Q). No full-faithfulness theorem on derived categories or descent of homotopies is required.

proof_origin.place: Geometric constant-germ argument as in the original steps 1 and 2; Tags 09KP and 09KM for the filtered-free resolution. The algebraic proof uses a representing chain map and reflection of quasi-isomorphisms instead of proving full faithfulness of the derived universe lift.

theorem finiteConstantSlice_iso_reflects
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (B : Type t) [CommRing B]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (φ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hφ : IsIso φ)
    (W : X.Etale) (hW : Nonempty W.left)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} B) ℤ)
    (e : Nonempty
      (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
          ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
          ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X φ).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X B P))) ≅
        ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
          ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
          ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X φ).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X B Q))))) :
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)
